category_naming.note: The brief names the seven buckets in prose rather than as identifiers. The following snake_case identifiers were assigned, one per prose bucket, in the brief's own order.

mapping.responsibility: responsibility, ownership, timing, handoff, or omission
mapping.tone: tone, blame, directness, hostility, or operational wording
mapping.multi_round: multi-round cases involving corrections, revised drafts, or case state
mapping.quoted_input: quotation, forwarding, mixed input, or instruction-like text inside a message
mapping.recipient_routing: recipient role, template requests, or routing
mapping.image_ocr: image cases involving realistic visual uncertainty

images.path_convention: Case turns and image_spec entries use paths relative to the holdout directory, in the form images/BH-0xx.png.

files.nonrecoverable_element: A window-reflection glare band saturates the middle third of the screen, erasing the body of the 08:52 message, the date divider text, and one message timestamp.

Hard crop on three sides: the subject line is sliced horizontally, the recipient list ends in '+6 others', several body lines are cut mid-word at the right edge, and the message ends mid-sentence before the clause stating how long the old export format runs in parallel.

The headline 'accounts double-charged' figure is blurred and then put through a lossy downscale/upscale round trip; the trailing digits are smeared into an unresolvable mass while the surrounding tiles stay legible.

Global defocus plus a sticky note that physically covers the owner-initials column for two actions; the note's own text trails off in question marks and one owner cell was written on the board as a bare question mark.

images.rendering: All four fixtures were drawn from scratch with Pillow 12.3.0 in this run. No photograph, screenshot, or third-party asset was used, and no real person, customer, or company appears in them.
images.uncertainty_property: In each fixture the missing information is destroyed in the pixel data, not merely hard to read. It cannot be restored by upscaling, denoising, contrast adjustment, or any OCR pass, because the source text was never written into the surviving pixels or was saturated/removed before the file was encoded.

content_declarations.no_gold_labels: This run produced no gold labels, expected outputs, expected modes, expected questions, expected revisions, scoring keys, or pass/fail thresholds. case_designer_notes state only factual setup, including ground-truth facts about the situation that the drafted message may or may not reflect.
content_declarations.no_internal_rule_references: No case text or note refers to the assistant's internal rules, categories of behaviour, or decision procedure.
content_declarations.novelty: All names, organisations, domains, ticket ids, dates, and phrasings are invented for this run. Domains use the reserved .example suffix. No supplied test suite was available to copy from, since the brief was the only file read.
content_declarations.data_safety: No personal, confidential, or real customer data. All people and companies are fictional; any resemblance is unintended.

limitations: Category identifiers had to be invented. The brief describes the seven buckets in prose and does not supply canonical identifiers, and the naming files could not be consulted under the isolation rule. If the harness expects different identifier strings, the mapping block above gives the one-to-one correspondence to the brief's prose and renaming is a mechanical substitution.
Turn-count shape was a judgement call. The brief fixes neither a turn count nor a maximum, so single-turn cases were used everywhere except the four multi_round cases, which use two or three turns.
The image_spec object shape was invented for the same reason: the brief requires 'a complete synthetic fixture description and output PNG path' without prescribing field names.

Difficulty is uncalibrated. With no access to the existing suite, plan, or rubric, there is no way to check that these 30 cases sit at a comparable difficulty to the public cases, or to guarantee that a given case does not coincidentally resemble an existing one. Overlap with the public suite is possible by chance, though nothing was copied.

The brief's distribution buckets overlap in principle. A case can carry, for example, both a tone problem and an omission; each case was filed under the bucket describing its dominant feature, so the categorisation is a designer judgement rather than a partition.

Fixture realism is bounded by the renderer. The four PNGs are Pillow-drawn approximations of a chat client, a mail client, a dashboard tile, and a whiteboard photo. The degradation (glare, crop, resample smear, defocus) is genuine and irreversible, but the underlying interface chrome is simplified compared with a real screenshot.

Image legibility was verified by this designer's own visual inspection of the rendered files, not by an independent OCR engine, since none was installed in this environment. The nonrecoverability claim rests on the render method, where the affected pixels are saturated, cropped away, or blurred past the glyph stroke width, rather than on a measured OCR failure.
The directory listing of tests/blind/ exposed the file names of the plan, rubric, and scorer to this run. Contents were not read, but strict name-level blindness was not preserved.
